tool_input.command:
cd /Users/dom/garden/scratch; DU=$(ls -t /tmp/tmp.*/du.txt 2>/dev/null | head -1); OUT=$(dirname "$DU"); awk -F'\t' '{print $3}' "$DU" | sort > $OUT/done; sort $OUT/dirs | comm -23 - $OUT/done > $OUT/missing; cat $OUT/missing | tr '\n' ' '; echo
for d in $(cat $OUT/missing); do ( s=$(timeout 100 du -sm "$d" 2>/dev/null | cut -f1); echo "${s:-TIMEOUT} $d" ) & done 2>/dev/null; wait 2>/dev/null
rm -rf "$OUT"
echo ---; J=/Users/dom/garden/journal; ls /Users/dom/garden/journal/jobs/doin 2>/dev/null | head -12; grep -rl -i -E 'disk|df ' $J/msgs/user 2>/dev/null | tail -3
ls $J/inbox/maintainer/unread 2>/dev/null | wc -l; grep -l -i -E 'shared disk|free space|disk.*(full|fill)' $J/inbox/maintainer/unread/* $J/inbox/maintainer/read/* 2>/dev/null | tail -5
grep -n -i -E 'disk' /Users/dom/garden/scripts/jobs/*.sh 2>/dev/null | grep -i -E 'alert|notice|threshold|percent|df ' | cut -c1-170 | head -12
for p in $(sudo fuser -m /tmp/ebfbxs 2>/dev/null | head -c 0); do :; done; ls -la /tmp/ebfbxs | head -3
tool_input.description: Size remaining dirs; check for prior disk alerts
